title: Gene Krupa upstairs
summary: Jones recalls never meeting Gene Krupa because Krupa was always upstairs in the hotel when Jones played downstairs.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, you see in my book, you know I have an aside, see. I could never get with Gene because Gene would always be upstairs. I said, "Where's Gene?" after

I left Minneapolis and saw him with Buddy Rogers. I said, "Where's Gene?" "You talking about Gene Krupa? He's upstairs." Gene used to get the room upstairs and I would be playing the drums downstairs and it was just because of the situation.
